why: Company release (via finviz) says Q2 FY2027 results come out 2026-10-19 shortly after 16:00 ET, with a Zoom call 2026-10-20 at 08:00 ET. A MarketBeat preview citing 10-13 is wrong. The baseline history is 6-K text matches about 6 days apart, which are not earnings.
session_evidence: Results 'shortly after 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time' on Monday 2026-10-19, call Tuesday 08:00 ET (https://finviz.com/news/398710/karooooo-to-announce-second-quarter-2027-results-on-october-19-2026), so the print is amc.
where_to_look: Cartrack subscriber net adds, the KPI the stock trades on. Q1 posted a record 142,472 net adds (+70% y/y). Check South African vehicle-sales data (NAAMSA, September) and app-store review volume for the Cartrack app as a proxy
ZAR/USD over June-August against the 'current exchange rates' assumption in the FY27 guidance (subscription revenue ZAR 5.7-6.0bn, EPS ZAR 38.50-40). Rand strength cut Q1 international earnings
Shares are thin (77k a day) with no listed options, so any change in the controlling shareholder's or the JSE secondary listing's share count and float is worth checking in 6-Ks
already_in_the_wire: Q1 FY27: record operating profit ZAR 410m, FY27 guidance reaffirmed, shares -1.7% after hours and lower later on FX (https://www.fxleaders.com/news/2026/07/15/karooooo-share-price-stays-bullish-despite-dip-after-strong-q1-performance-and-outlook-reaffirmation/)
No subscriber guidance is given, by policy (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/karooooo-q1-earnings-call-highlights-2026-07-16/)
trades_on: Subscriber adds and the FY guide in rand terms. Q1 was a beat with the guide reaffirmed, and the stock dipped on FX, so the guide and currency translation moved it more than the beat did (https://www.fxleaders.com/news/2026/07/15/karooooo-share-price-stays-bullish-despite-dip-after-strong-q1-performance-and-outlook-reaffirmation/).
short_interest: 147.5k shares short, 1.58 days to cover, FINRA settlement 2026-06-30 via CurvedTrading (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/karo/). Percent of float unknown; MarketBeat gave about 1.3% of shares outstanding on 2026-03-13.
